_comment: Timed events (V): data-driven start and end (UTC), bonuses applied while they run (they multiply when events overlap), and a gift each player can claim once. Launch events (V: generous, 1, 2, 3 weeks then 1, 2, 3 months) use `launch_days` [from, to], counted from `launch_at` (V sets the real launch date); other events use `starts_at` / `ends_at`. Bonuses: mana (x reward), xp (x), drop_rate (x chance of monster/item/scroll drops), energy_cost (x, rounded up), cosmetic_points (x the cosmetic points each summon gives, rounded up; V: events add cosmetic points). Few light & dark scrolls (V). PLACEHOLDER numbers.
